skillset.skill: 14s CT - 4000% Water DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 30. If used during Third Eye (Zero), increase own Arts by an additional 20.
skillset.arts:
25000% Water DMG (PHY). Increase allies' (except self) Arts by 20. Additionally if used during Third Eye (Zero), for 7s, increase >50% HP Allies' Arts by 5/s.
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type F and will not stack with other Type F Arts Gen.
skillset.truearts: 100000% Water DMG (PHY). For 20s, reduce enemies' PHY RES by 150%.
skillset.superarts: For 180s, enter Third Eye. During Third Eye (Zero): 300000% Water DMG (PHY). For 20s, increase allies' CRI DMG by 300%. Additionally, reduce remaining Third Eye (Zero) duration by 30s.

passive.ability1: When in Third Eye or Third Eye Zero, increase own CRI rate by 100% and Super CRI rate by 70%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: When Third Eye is activated, activate Third Eye Zero instead if there are no other Human allies (except self) in party. When in Third Eye Zero, increase own Super CRI rate by an additional 30% and stats by 30%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.

trueweapon.name: Weeping Mist
trueweapon.skill: 60s CT - 8000% Water DMG (PHY). For 8s, reduce enemies' Water RES by 40%. Additionally if user is Human, for 8s, increase own DMG by 50%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Mizuki the 12th, Seven Heavens Armor, increase own DMG by 50% and Third Eye duration by 30s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
